ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) pixels with a localized high-intensity (white) distribution of approximately 20% concentrated on the right lobe tip and scattered rosettes.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity white pixel clusters concentrated on the right lobe tip; scattered 2D circular white spots across the right lobe; left lobe displays high-intensity pixel streaks near the trailing edge against a primarily low-intensity black field.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated internal pixel angle of approximately 65 degrees and a high depth-to-width ratio.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Frequent, irregular serrations with pixel-amplitudes of 3-8 pixels; trailing edge exhibits jagged topography with distinct peaks on the distal portion of the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Asymmetrical convexity; the right lobe displays a rounded, convex sweep toward the tip, while the left lobe exhibits a flatter, more linear trajectory terminating in a sharper point.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular white-on-black pixel clusters distributed across the right lobe, particularly visible in the upper-medial region.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several vertical, unaligned linear pixel disruptions (high-intensity streaks) visible on the right lobe, oriented perpendicular to the trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive high-contrast mottled scarring and honeycomb-like textural anomalies covering the terminal edge of the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique high-intensity white 'netted' pattern on the lower right-hand edge of the fluke lobe, creating a distinct lattice effect against the water background.
